meet.label: FROM RIO WITH FIRE
meet.title: The man behind the fire.
meet.badge: RIO DE JANEIRO — WHERE IT STARTED
meet.copy: Straight from Rio de Janeiro to Florida, Carioca brings a passion for authentic Brazilian churrasco. A master of live-fire barbecue, Bruno brings true Carioca warmth and craftsmanship to your event.
meet.note: 🗣️ Note: Bruno is a native Brazilian churrasqueiro (speaks Portuguese). Full bilingual customer support is available for scheduling and event planning!
meet.slogan: "More than a barbecue, an unforgettable experience!"
meet.resenha_copy: Long before Florida, he built his name the Brazilian way — skewer in one hand and hours of resenha around the grill. The cold beer stayed in Rio. The fire came with him.
meet.resenha_note: resenha (n.) — the untranslatable Brazilian art of good company around the fire.

faq.label: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.q1: Which Florida cities does BBQ Carioca serve?
faq.a1: We serve all of South Florida, including Boca Raton, Delray Beach, Palm Beach, Fort Lauderdale, Miami, West Palm Beach, and surrounding areas. For corporate or larger events, we also serve Orlando.
faq.q2: What is included in the catering packages?
faq.a2: Our packages include a professional Pitmaster (Chef Bruno), charcoal grill setup, prime beef cuts (Picanha, Top Sirloin, Ribs, Sausages), appetizers (garlic bread), traditional sides (farofa, vinaigrette, rice), premium disposable plates & cutlery, and grill area cleanup.
faq.q3: How long does the BBQ service last during the event?
faq.a3: We arrive 2 hours prior to serving time to set up and start the fire. The continuous live barbecue buffet service lasts 3 to 4 hours for your guests.
faq.q4: What is the minimum and maximum guest capacity?
faq.a4: We cater from small backyard parties (starting at 15 guests) to large corporate functions, birthdays, and weddings with over 200 guests.
faq.q5: How does date reservation and payment work?
faq.a5: To reserve your event date, we require a 20% deposit. The remaining balance is paid on the day of the event. We accept Zelle, Credit Cards, Venmo, and Cash.
faq.q6: What if it rains on the day of my event?
faq.a6: Our team provides professional rain tents for the grill area. The fire stays hot and your event runs smoothly regardless of weather!
faq.q7: Can we customize the menu or request dietary options (chicken, pork, veggies)?
faq.a7: Absolutely! Beyond our signature Picanha and premium beef, we offer grilled chicken, pork ribs, grilled pineapple with cinnamon, and side options tailored to your guests' preferences.
